ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an insect life cycle, with circular arrows connecting four labeled stages. Next to the label D on the left is a very small oval, representing an egg. Looking upward and to the right along the arrow starting from D, the next stage is label A, in which several worm-like, maggot-like bodies are drawn. Reasoning: after the egg, the arrow points to A, and the worm-like form of A corresponds to the larval stage. Therefore, the stage directly after egg is larval.
